name: Each event once, as it now stands
says: the calendar the person holds is the one RFC 5546 describes: replies, cancellations and requests change the event they name, and nothing is dated by when it arrived

measures.says: replies, cancellations, refresh requests and counter-proposals among the validation oracles' calendar examples (test/oracle/corpus.json) that show as events of their own
oracle calendar examples with no DTSTART or DUE that are placed at the time they arrived
